'''Jaybo Hood''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

===Captivity on Iego===
[[File:JayboHammock-MoaTM.png|thumb|left|250x250px|Jaybo lounges on his hammock strung between two Vulture droid legs]]

A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" /> born in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="JHA" /> Jaybo Hood was one of several individuals who found themselves captive on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. After the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] abandoned Iego in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jaybo reprogrammed the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] left behind, and used them as servants<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" /> to cater to his every whim.<ref name="tcwce" /> He used a [[Macro protocol/Legends|macro protocol]] to wipe all of their programming simultaneously. When [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived on the planet looking for an [[Reeksa/Legends|ingredient]] in the antidote to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]], the latter brashly destroyed eighteen of the defenseless droids.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />

Hood served as their guide around the planet and its creatures and grew fond of the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during their stay. Jaybo told the two Jedi of "[[Drol/Legends|Drol]]," the "god" of Iego, even mentioning [[Taquito/Legends|Taquito]], a friend of his who was killed upon attempting to leave the planet. Skywalker and Kenobi attempted to leave the planet themselves but were stopped by a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|laser field]] installed by the Separatists to prevent its inhabitants from leaving. Jaybo lent them several of his commandeered [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droids]] to help them get off-planet and destroy the field. In doing so, Hood indirectly helped free all the marooned inhabitants of Iego, allowing them to leave whenever they wished.<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />

===The return of Drol===
{{Quote|Gentlemen, it appears the son of Drol lives.|Jaybo Hood, to Skywalker and Kenobi|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)">[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]]</ref>}}
Not long after, Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi returned to Iego and Jaybo told them about a mysterious situation taking place in the planet's orbit. After they checked it out, they discovered it was assassin droid [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] who was running out after successfully executing the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]]. When he was discovered, 3D escaped and fled away from the planet.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I knew he needed a lot of gear since he was a tinkerer and had rebuilt all of these battle droids. Dave suggested I think of him as a cross between a young Anakin and a young Han Solo.|[[Wayne Lo]] on creating Jaybo Hood|<ref name="The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>}}
Jaybo Hood was voiced by [[David Kaufman]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] television series [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] episode "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]."<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" />
